participation.context: Answered Joan, showed the death with a spoon, and sent Edmund back to school.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Put the gloves on, kept the meal to the food, and left Susanna unread.
participation.name: Anne Shakespeare

participation.context: Counted the stitch, recognised his own knee, and did not punish it.
participation.name: John Shakespeare

participation.context: Kept the bread, and did not take a speech.
participation.name: Mary Shakespeare

participation.context: Asked about paint, and refused to carry Edmund's ambition to the kitchen.
participation.name: Joan Shakespeare

participation.context: Passed the salt, and said nothing.
participation.name: Richard Shakespeare

participation.context: Asked for the death, and was told to finish school.
participation.name: Edmund Shakespeare

participation.context: Sat with yesterday's book, and was not asked to read it out.
participation.name: Susanna Shakespeare

participation.context: Followed the spoon's hinge, and left the dying to Edmund.
participation.name: Hamnet Shakespeare

participation.context: Did her grandfather's walk once, and stopped at the rule she had set.
participation.name: Judith Shakespeare

story.body: You let the table talk across itself. The gloves were counted and worn. You showed a death with a spoon, and then it was a spoon again. A walk was recognised and left alone. You did not pay anyone, and you did not make Susanna perform.

title: Sat tenth at the Lenten table
